name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the generated continuation is connected to the context and the preceding conversation. A relevant response maintains the topic and flow, while an irrelevant response strays off-topic or introduces unrelated information.
scale: 0-3 (0: Completely irrelevant, 1: Barely related, 2: Somewhat relevant, 3: Fully relevant)

name: Coherence
description: Assesses the logical consistency and grammatical correctness of the generated continuation. A coherent response is well-structured and easy to understand, whereas an incoherent response may contain errors in syntax, semantics, or logic.
scale: 0-3 (0: Incoherent, 1: Somewhat incoherent, 2: Mostly coherent, 3: Fully coherent)

name: Engagement
description: Evaluates the ability of the generated continuation to stimulate further conversation or interest in the topic. An engaging response piques curiosity, introduces new information, or provokes thought, while a disengaging response fails to encourage continued discussion.
scale: 0-3 (0: Disengaging, 1: Somewhat engaging, 2: Mostly engaging, 3: Fully engaging)

name: Creativity
description: Measures the originality and inventiveness of the generated continuation. A creative response introduces novel ideas, perspectives, or connections, while a non-creative response merely repeats information or provides uninspired replies.
scale: 0-3 (0: Not creative, 1: Somewhat creative, 2: Mostly creative, 3: Highly creative)

name: Fluency
description: Assesses the naturalness and fluency of the generated continuation. A fluent response is smooth, idiomatic, and indistinguishable from human-written text, while a disfluent response may sound robotic, stilted, or unnatural.
scale: 0-3 (0: Disfluent, 1: Somewhat fluent, 2: Mostly fluent, 3: Fully fluent)
